reason: Paper 2 is a carefully controlled benchmark of 11 optimizers for LLM pretraining: about 2900 runs, varying model size, batch size and horizon, with per-optimizer tuning and documented hyperparameter sweeps. It also reports actionable, sometimes counter-intuitive findings, such as D-Muon versus Muon, the beta2 and weight-decay effects, the codebase defaults that flip SOAP's ranking, and the Sophia and Signum implementation issues, though it lacks seeds and error bars and stops at 720M parameters. Paper 1 only runs three existing distillers on noisy CIFAR and Tiny-ImageNet and compares them against plain cross-entropy on the full noisy data. It has no noisy-label-learning baselines, its 'corollaries' are unsupported, and its privacy and efficiency claims are asserted without evidence, so its contribution and soundness are much weaker.
